name: Myeong A-yeon
source:
A childhood friend of the protagonist who has somehow gotten herself turned into a mermaid.
Usually a shy and somewhat introverted girl, but, when she's with Hiroto, she sometimes uses her tail to express how she feels... By hitting him with it!
